2: A Song, a Psalm of David. My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
3: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
4: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
5: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
6: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
7: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
8: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
9: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
10: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.
11: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
12: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
13: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
14: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
